newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela puts posts on Colombian border on alert.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela puts posts on Colombian border on alert.

text.p: Venezuelan border posts on Tuesday were placed on alert against reprisals after an army patrol killed three presumed Colombian guerrillas in Venezuelan territory, Defence Minister Tito Rincon said.
A gunbattle occurred on Monday evening in the southwestern state of Apure when a patrol of Venezuelan paratroopers surprised about 25 to 30 heavily armed men, Rincon told reporters.
Helicopters and Bronco planes were sent as backup forces, and the area was searched. Three corpses with AK-47 assault rifles were found lying nearby.
"We will continue to exercise our control and our sovereignty in this region," Rincon said.
Five civilians were arrested and are being questioned, "because they had no reason to be there," Rincon said.
Three hours later, Venezuelan soldiers in the area came under attack again, this time from machine gun and mortar fire.
Neither attack caused any injuries among the Venezuelan troops, Rincon said.
The incidents occurred in the same area in which a Venezuelan paratrooper was injured six days ago when his five-man patrol was ambushed by a column of presumed Colombian guerrillas.
Venezuela frequently criticises Colombia for inadequate security along the 1,400-mile (2,200-km) border, where smuggling, kidnapping and armed skirmishes have become increasingly frequent.
